# Bundled ADOFAI-IPC v2

Verified Release DLLs from the revision in source.json. Contracts and Loader retain assembly identity 1.0.0.0; product version is 2.0.0 and wire protocol is 3. SHA256SUMS pins the complete runtime bundle. Consumer mods reference only Contracts and Loader. Copy all four files together and restart the game after replacing a bundle.
